after.rosterkit/notices.py:
# owner: platform
"""Absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def _absences(student: Student, marks: List[Mark]):
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ProjectError("mark for another student")
    missed = days_missed(marks)
    if not missed:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to report")
    return missed


# ---
def absence_notice(
    student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]
) -> str:
    missed = _absences(student, list(marks))
    dates = ", ".join(item.isoformat() for item in missed)
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    return f"{name} missed {len(missed)} day(s): {dates}."
after.tests/test_notices.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

PUPIL = Student("1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1", date(2026, 9, 9), "absent"),
            Mark("1", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent"),
            Mark("1", date(2026, 9, 3), "present"),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks),
            "Ada Lovelace missed 2 day(s): "
            "2026-09-02, 2026-09-09.",
        )

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [Mark("2", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [Mark("1", date(2026, 9, 2), "excused")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
